findings.title: Incomplete batch handling loses trailing payouts
findings.explanation: The _chunk function uses integer division (batch_count = len(payouts) // size) which drops the remainder. With 350 payouts and size 200, only 1 batch is created, losing 150 payouts.
findings.recommendation: Use math.ceil or handle remainder explicitly: return [payouts[i*size:(i+1)*size] for i in range((len(payouts) + size - 1) // size)]

findings.title: F-string in log statement violates structured logging convention
findings.explanation: Team requires constant snake_case event names with keyword arguments for Datadog event grouping. F-strings prevent log grouping and require regex-parsing.
findings.recommendation: Change to: log.info("payout_batches_submitted", batch_count=len(batch_ids), merchant_id=merchant_id, currency=currency)

findings.title: Potential DetachedInstanceError from closed session
findings.explanation: The pending list contains Payout objects from a session that closes at line 18. If bank_transfers.submit_batch (line 23) accesses lazy-loaded attributes, SQLAlchemy will raise DetachedInstanceError.
findings.recommendation: Either eagerly load all needed attributes in the query, or restructure to keep the session open across the entire function. Alternatively, extract only needed data into plain dicts before the session closes.
